values.note: Operator's rate table (per site; the table names no year, read 2026-10-25 on the current site): summer (May 1 - Oct 15) 30-amp camper sites $38-42, 50-amp $48-52, full hookup $50-55 (30 A) / $60-65 (50 A); winter (Oct 16 - Apr 30) camper sites only, $62 (30 A) / $72 (50 A), no full hookups. Weekly rates are about six nights' price. 50 amps is chosen as an add-on in the booking engine. Payment in full at booking plus 12% sales/room tax; refunds keep a 10% service fee.

fees.source: https://www.wildernessresortllc.com/camping (CAMPGROUND RATES: per-site NIGHTLY SUMMER (05/01-10/15), NIGHTLY WINTER (10/16-04/30), weekly) + https://www.wildernessresortllc.com/policies ('PAYMENT IN FULL AT TIME OF BOOKING PLUS 12% sales/room tax'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.wildernessresortllc.com/camping (sites 1, 3, 5, 15 '30 AMP FULL HOOKUP SITE' / '50 AMP FULL HOOKUP SITE'; 'NO FULL HOOKUP in winter months from 10/16-04/30') + ResNexus booking page ('all sites are considered 30 Amp sites. If you need 50 Amps then you'll need to select "1" from the drop-down'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Sites 1-15 on the rate table; site 7 is a camper cabin, leaving 14 RV/tent sites (4 full hookup: 1, 3, 5, 15). 'Sites 2 & 9 are larger pull through sites and good options for larger rigs'; site 10 is a larger back-in; sites 1 and 3 the larger full-hookup back-ins. No lengths posted: the operator asks campers to check the site size, and there is no overflow lot.

sites.source: https://www.wildernessresortllc.com/camping (rate table, sites 1-15) + ResNexus booking page ('CAMPING - THINGS TO KNOW'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Camper sites are sold all winter (Oct 16 - Apr 30) at winter rates; full hookups only May 1 - Oct 15.

season.source: https://www.wildernessresortllc.com/camping (NIGHTLY WINTER (10/16-04/30) rates for camper sites) + https://www.wildernessresortllc.com/policies ('Reservations may be made year round'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Booked online through the operator's ResNexus page ('Book Your Stay'), by phone or through Google Hotels, up to one year ahead. Memorial Day, Fourth of July and Labor Day weekends need 3 nights including Friday and Saturday. 'No maximum stay.' One camper or tent and one vehicle per site.

booking.source: https://www.wildernessresortllc.com/policies (CAMPGROUND RESERVATION POLICY: 'up to one (1) year in advance', 'requires a three (3) night stay to include Friday and Saturday', 'No maximum stay') + ResNexus booking page, read 2026-10-25

note: Small year-round resort on Lac La Belle in the Keweenaw: a handful of numbered RV sites (some full hookup) beside a camper cabin and lodging. Generators only when the utility power is out, 9 AM - 9 PM. --Claude
summary: Operator's site + ResNexus booking page: confirmed 50 A / water / sewer and year-round; fees widened 38-65 -> 38-72 (winter camper sites $62/$72 nightly); added 14 RV sites with 2 pull-throughs, dump, ResNexus booking a year ahead, 3-night holiday minimum, no maximum. Not long-stay in character (nightly rates on every site, weekly is just a discount, no monthly/seasonal offer). Rate table carries no year (current site, read 2026-10-25). Base $38 is under the US$50 line. Phone matches. No rig lengths posted.
